_about: Every reference kept for Takanashi Hoshino. ONLY official Blue Archive art (Nexon Games / Yostar; character illustrator & designer: 9ml per the game's own profile data). 'official' = the game's own texture or a lossless re-composition of the game's own Spine parts in their setup pose; nothing here is redrawn, upscaled or fan-made. Rebuild: python3 assets/ba/ref/hoshino/_build/build_refs.py <repo-root> <dev-root>. This folder has a .gdignore so Godot does not import it.

files.what: Full-body standing illustration, 673x1024, transparent. Yawning wink pose, shotgun in right hand, folded shield-case slung at left hip.
files.why_official: SchaleDB serves the game's own student portrait texture (same image as the in-game student info / recruitment art); it is the same illustration as the game's Spine standing sprite below (a flattened render of it with face 00_default; ~1.4 % smaller, so not pixel-identical).

files.source: re-assembled from the game's Spine standing sprite 'hoshino_spr' (atlas .dev/spine/hoshino_spr/hoshino_spr.png + slot placement .dev/rig/hoshino/assembly.json extracted from hoshino_spr.skel) using face '01_normal'
files.what: Same illustration with the official neutral face (both eyes open: gold RIGHT eye, blue LEFT eye), fringe overlay and halo layers in their setup positions. 580x1037.
files.why_official: Every pixel comes from the game's Spine atlas; only placed (no scaling of the body, faces / halo placed at the skeleton's setup coordinates).

files.source: game file Spine_Characters/hoshino_spr/hoshino_spr.png (as mirrored in the kiraio-moe/Schale-Archive extraction; local copy .dev/spine/hoshino_spr/hoshino_spr.png)
files.what: Untouched 1024x1024 atlas: faceless body (rotated), 18 face parts, eyeclose overlay, 3 halo layers, front-hair overlay. The shotgun appears HORIZONTAL here (best side-view gun reference).
files.why_official: It is the game's texture file itself.

files.source: all 18 face attachments + the 'eyeclose' blink overlay of hoshino_spr, each composited on the official head in setup pose; label strips added
files.what: 00_default ... 17_boring at native resolution, for expressions. The last tile is the blink overlay laid over 01_normal (in-game it is animated; at setup pose it reads as half-lidded).
files.why_official: Game pixels only; the dark label strips are the only added pixels.

files.source: halo 1/2/3 layers of hoshino_spr in setup pose (additive glow copies omitted)
files.what: The halo: outer split ellipse with side bars and long horizontal spikes, a thin middle ellipse, a thick inner ring. 257x77.
